summary: Tested the sign-in fix, home captions, worker payroll (API + Profile UI), chat photos, shift reminders and group workchats, plus a direct-chat regression. Backend: 26/26 new pytest pass and 12/12 from iteration 1 still pass. Node unit tests: 7/7 pass. The 5 accounts sign in through the API and through the UI (home -> 'Sign in' -> Enter). 35 bad logins in a row gave no 429, and a different account could still sign in. Payroll API: validation works (HELLO, S1257L Scottish, bad NI category, missing confirm, bad payType all return 400 with the right message), employers get 403, payslips show the one contractor slip (week 31, £213.75). For the end-to-end check I added a £500 approved checkout dated after the PAYE switch: it produced a separate PAYE slip (tax 51.62, NI 20.64, employer NI 60.60, net 427.74), then I deleted it. Chat photo API: send, has_image, image fetch, worker2 gets 404, gif/URL/bad base64 give 400, and a photo with no text gets the body '📷 Photo'. Shift reminder: it shows once in conversation 1 with the time and Victoria Park address; a forced run returns sent:0; a worker gets 403. UI: the home welcome panel and carousel captions are correct. Profile payroll renders correctly. Photo upload in the worker chat room works and the bubble appears. Text send and the GIPHY grid work. Group workchat (made a temporary TEST workchat, removed afterwards): full screen on worker mobile, and tapping a message shows the reaction picker. Found 5 bugs, 2 of them high: (1) workchat one-tap reactions never send; (2) on employer desktop the workchat composer is hidden under the bottom nav, so employers can't type. The other 3: payroll errors don't show in the UI, the photo lightbox isn't full screen, and the visible 'How we work' section text was not updated.

minor.issue: Login no longer locks out. But the X-RateLimit-Remaining header on 28 requests from one client jumped between about 5 separate counters (99,98,97,99,96,...). So the limiter key is an intermediate proxy/edge IP, not the real client IP. The hop count seems to be about 3 (Cloudflare -> ingress -> FastAPI shim -> node). Users still share a few buckets (about 500 requests per 15 min in total). Faking X-Forwarded-For did not create a new bucket, which is good. Consider TRUST_PROXY=3 or keying on CF-Connecting-IP / the first untrusted hop.

Payslips are grouped by tax week AND pay_type. If a worker switches mid-week, the same tax week gets two payslips. The PAYE slip then gets a full week's personal allowance and NI threshold on its own, while the contractor part is ignored, so the worker could pay too little. Acceptable for an MVP, but document it or pro-rate.
N+1 pattern: runs history plus a checkouts query per worker, with no paging or date filter. Will be slow at scale.

The message is inserted before the shift_chat_reminders row (INSERT IGNORE). If two runs overlap (timer plus a manual run, or 2 instances), the same reminder is sent twice. Insert the reminder row first inside a transaction, or claim it first with INSERT and check affectedRows.

ui_bugs.issue: One-tap reaction does nothing. Tapping 👍 closes the picker and sends no POST /reactions (confirmed with a network listener). RCA: the global capture-phase pointerdown handler closeOpenSections (App.jsx ~line 15-25) finds the open message bubble (div.workchat-message-bubble[aria-expanded=true]). The picker is NOT inside .workchat-message-bubble (closest() returns null), so the handler calls trigger.click(). That clears selectedWorkchatMessageId, and the picker unmounts before its onClick runs. A programmatic element.click() (no pointerdown) works: POST 200 and the reaction shows. The Reply button in .workchat-message-actions probably fails the same way (clicking Reply showed no reply preview). Fix: add '.workchat-reaction-picker' and '.workchat-message-actions' (or a common message-row wrapper) to the containers list, or render them inside the bubble container.

The composer form.workchat-composer (y 1006-1080) is covered by the employer bottom nav; elementFromPoint returns the nav button. The employer can't see or type a message in an open workchat. The worker view hides the header and nav when a workchat is open (condition user.role==='worker'&&inboxTab==='workchats'&&workchatOpenId, App.jsx ~line 795), but the employer view does not, so the room is not really full screen for employers.

Saving an invalid tax code (HELLO), a Scottish code (S1257L) or PAYE without the confirm box shows NO message in the UI. The API returns 400 with the right text. RCA: App.jsx line 930 renders <WorkerPayroll setNotice={setNotice}/> without setError, so the error goes to the default no-op. Fix: pass setError, or show an inline error inside the component.

The lightbox is not full screen. It is drawn inside the message row (measured 1459x218 at y=677 on 1920x1080), and the image overflows it and is clipped. RCA: .hz-row has animation hzMsg with fill-mode both, which leaves a transform (computed matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)). That makes the row the containing block for position:fixed. .hz-room also has a transform. Fix: render the lightbox with ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body), or drop fill-mode 'both' on the row animation.

issues: The nav 'How we work' button scrolls to the intro carousel. Its lead text is still the old copy ('Find shifts that fit your availability...' / 'Plan staffing needs, reach suitable workers...') with no PAYE/contractor or staffing+accounting message. The new summaries were only added to the showHowItWorks panel, which this button closes (setShowHowItWorks(false)), so users never see them.
The active carousel tab pill ('How we work · Workers') is pink text on a pink background and barely readable.
The About us text still lists warehouse/office as sectors, which is a little off from the new hospitality/festivals/retail focus.
The hovered/active Inbox nav item turns into a black block with dark-red text, which is low contrast.
The Sign-out icon is the same as the Sign-in icon (arrow into a box), which is confusing.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the workchat reaction picker and message actions being closed by the global pointerdown handler closeOpenSections (add .workchat-reaction-picker/.workchat-message-actions to the containers list).
HIGH: Make the employer workchat full screen like the worker one (hide the bottom nav/header when workchatOpenId is set), so the composer is visible and usable.
Pass setError to <WorkerPayroll> (App.jsx:930) so tax-code, Scottish-code and confirm errors show.
Render the ChatPhoto lightbox in a portal to document.body so it covers the full screen.
Update the visible 'How we work' carousel copy (public-intro-lead for workers and employers) with the PAYE/contractor and staffing+accounting message, and fix the low-contrast active tab pill.
Optional: tune TRUST_PROXY (the limiter key is currently an intermediate proxy IP), and make shift reminders idempotent under concurrent runs.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is several thousand lines with very long JSX lines. Split the Home, Inbox/Workchat and Profile parts into modules; it makes bugs like the pointerdown one hard to spot.
payroll-routes settingAt compares date strings. That is fine only because db.js uses dateStrings:true and timezone 'Z'; it breaks if that config changes.
Images are stored base64 in MEDIUMTEXT in the messages table, with a JSON body limit of 1mb. OK for an MVP, but it bloats the DB and backups; consider object storage.

image_data and other chat columns are added lazily in ensureDirectExtras(), only on the first chat request. The column did not exist until a conversation endpoint was called; a SQL query against image_data before that fails.

success_rate.frontend: about 70% (sign-in, captions, payroll render, photo send, GIF, text send, workchat full screen on worker mobile OK; reactions, employer composer, payroll errors, lightbox, How-we-work copy failing)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all removed by id: checkout with worker_comment TEST_iter2 (deleted); direct messages 21, 22, 29, 30 (photo/text) and 23-28 (placeholders from the iteration-1 regression run) hard-deleted from conversation 1; workchat id 1 'TEST_iter2 workchat' with message 1, its reaction and read row (deleted); employer favourite of worker 1 (removed through the API). Audit-log rows and auto-increment counters from these actions remain. test.worker's pay settings were not changed; only rejected 400 PUTs were made.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Login inputs: input[type=email] and input[autocomplete=current-password]; the home link is .home-signin-link. Worker bottom nav: Dashboard/Jobs/Profile/Inbox; use get_by_role('button', name='Inbox').last. Conversation 1 = worker 1 and employer 4, holding seed messages 1-8, GIF 19 and reminder 20. To test workchats: as the employer, POST /api/employer/workers/1/favourite, then POST /api/workchats {name, participantIds:[1]}. Afterwards delete by id via SQL (workchats, workchat_participants, workchat_messages, workchat_message_reactions by workchat_id; workchat_message_reads by message_id) and DELETE the favourite. Workchat composer placeholder is 'Write a message…' (worker) / 'Type a message' (employer). The DB clock is Nov 2026 (tax week 31). Run pytest with -p no:xdist -o addopts=''.
rca of the issue: Sign-in bug fixed. Before the fix every user shared one rate-limit key (the proxy IP), so 100 requests per 15 min locked everyone out. With TRUST_PROXY=2 there was no lockout after 35 failed logins, and all 5 accounts sign in through the UI. The key is still an intermediate hop (about 5 rotating buckets), so the fix works but is not exact.
